comment_regular: Verified via direct caller data flow: reads the per-player last-selected destination-space index for a TESObjectDOOR, keyed by that door's refID at +0x0C, from PlayerCharacter offset +0x788. Returns 0xFF when door is null or no map value is found; the stored value is exposed as UInt8. The caller uses it to avoid immediately reusing the prior space when another destination can be selected.
